text:
leah: opened PR to correct the API reference for POST /v1/rerank (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/527). Found a few schema + example mismatches while validating the Python SDK.

leah: issues I hit:
- request body `queries` documented as `object` but runtime expects an array of strings (`string[]`). Generated clients were sending the wrong payload shape.
- response schema omits `scores` array (float[]) that we return alongside `ranked_ids`.
- docs example shows 201 Created; endpoint returns 200 OK. Some tests assert status code.
- cURL snippet in the reference omitted the Authorization header in one example block, causing CI snippet tests to fail.

tom: ouch. can you paste the current broken snippets so i can update openapi.yaml and the examples?

leah: current (incorrect) request schema in docs:```yaml
requestBody:
  content:
    application/json:
      schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          queries:
            type: object
            description: "Queries to rerank"
```
should be:```yaml
requestBody:
  content:
    application/json:
      schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          queries:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
            description: "List of query strings to rerank"
            minItems: 1
```

leah: response runtime returns (added to PR examples):```json
{
  "id": "r-999",
  "ranked_ids": ["doc-3", "doc-1", "doc-2"],
  "scores": [0.92, 0.87, 0.33],
  "model": "rerank-v1"
}
```
docs only listed `ranked_ids` which broke downstream scoring dashboards.

rachel: i'll update the OpenAPI: change `queries` -> array[string], add `scores` property: {type: array, items: {type: number, format: float}}, and ensure response status is 200 with proper example. Also fix cURL snippet to include `-H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"`.

anil: please add a short migration note under docs/migration/v1.8.md calling out the request shape change (object->array) because some teams generate typed clients that will break. Also add a tiny example showing how to iterate `scores` and `ranked_ids` together.

leah: added snippet in PR:```py
resp = client.rerank(body={"queries": ["q1", "q2"]})
for id, score in zip(resp['ranked_ids'], resp['scores']):
    print(id, score)
```

ci-bot: docs/lint found 1 missing Authorization header in docs/reference/rerank.md line 24

leah: fixed the cURL example and force-pushed. Also updated the example status code and OpenAPI examples.

ci-bot: All checks passed ✅ (lint, openapi-check, snippets)

tom: reviewed the OpenAPI changes. small nit: add `minItems: 1` to queries to avoid empty-batch edgecases. otherwise LGTM.

rachel: added `minItems: 1` and a note in the parameter description. pushed.

anil: approved from docs side. i'll follow up to propagate the example into JS and Go SDK READMEs and schedule a client regen job for typed SDKs.

leah: merged. thanks team — i'll open a follow-up to add a short test to the Python SDK that asserts `scores` length equals `ranked_ids` length to catch regressions. :tada:
